fib: ______ is a topic that also could be considered in risk assessment.
Animal welfare
Animal welfare is a topic that also could be considered in risk assessment.
______ is the various stages a proposed activity undergoes from proposal to approval for implementation.
EIA process
The EIA process is the various stages a proposed activity undergoes from proposal to approval for implementation.
______ is the compilation of the findings from an EIA activity or exercise.
Reporting
Reporting is the compilation of the findings from an EIA activity or exercise.
______ is concerned with reducing or minimising environmental impacts at all of these stages in the production process.
Life cycle assessment
Life cycle assessment is concerned with reducing or minimising environmental impacts at all of these stages in the production process.
______ is the various assessment activities and stages that a new proposal undergoes from inception to approval for implementation.
process
The process is the various assessment activities and stages that a new proposal undergoes from inception to approval for implementation.
______ is the analysis and evaluation of the uncertainty of unwanted potential environmental effects which could be problematic and the various measures to reduce risk.
Environmental risk assessment
Environmental risk assessment is the analysis and evaluation of the uncertainty of unwanted potential environmental effects which could be problematic and the various measures to reduce risk.
______ is a key activity to determine whether an EIA is required or not.
Screening
Screening is a key activity to determine whether an EIA is required or not.
